product_one_liner.value: Rasayel is a WhatsApp team inbox and automation platform for B2B sales teams (and support and retention teams) that centralizes conversations, automates follow-ups, and syncs WhatsApp with CRM systems.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage positions the product for sales, support, and retention, with B2B sales teams as its primary focus.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists Start and Grow plans with per-user prices and an Enterprise plan.

named_customers.notes: Both are featured as customers in Rasayel case studies.

employee_band.notes: GetLatka reports 28 employees as of July 2025, placing the company in the 21–50 band; LinkedIn gives a broader 11–50 size range.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies its headquarters as Remote, US; it does not identify a conventional city.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists Rasayel as founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible blog index consists of marketing, sales advice, product-related and customer-story posts; it does not show at least two engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Rasayel has a public documentation site with numerous product, setup, integration, and developer articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Rasayel job-board page reports zero jobs posted, so it lists no open AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Checked Rasayel's public documentation index and AI-support documentation, privacy/security materials, and blog. They discuss AI generally but do not identify the model or model provider used.

compliance_certs.notes: Reviewed the public security policy and privacy policy; no named certification from the requested list is claimed there. GDPR is discussed as a regulation in the privacy materials, not presented as a certification.

last_funding.notes: The reported Series A was announced October 5, 2026, with $10 million raised from Wamda Capital.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2026 Series A falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Rasayel job-board page reports zero jobs posted; no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated changelog item shown is April 28, 2026, before the six-month window starting May 9, 2026; no later launch or major feature announcement was found in the readable product update history.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page lists the full team and identifies co-founders Tarek Khalil (CEO) and Mohamed Elbadwihi (COO), but gives no evidence of a C-level or VP-level join or departure in the period; no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Rasayel publicly lists HubSpot, Pipedrive and Zapier integrations; its documentation/changelog also identifies its Zoho integration.
